* a disagreement shape behind the number has no verdict yet (docs/self_scan/graph_comparison_ledger.json): not a claim. n counts what recall is out of (import statements, calls, reference edges). Hubs: overlap of the top-10 PageRank files, and Spearman over their union (bar clamped at 0).
Call resolution is scored against the reference tool, not ground truth. Generated by tests/tools/graph_coverage_chart.py.
